products.name: iPhone
products.how_to_update: Settings › General › Software Update

products.name: iPad
products.how_to_update: Settings › General › Software Update

products.name: Apple Watch
products.how_to_update: On your iPhone: Watch app › General › Software Update

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch
products.how_to_update: Galaxy Wearable app on your phone › Watch settings › Watch software update

products.name: Google Pixel Watch
products.how_to_update: On the watch: Settings › System › System updates

products.name: Fitbit
products.how_to_update: Fitbit app › tap your device › tap Update if it is offered (keep the tracker near your phone)

products.name: Garmin watch
products.how_to_update: Garmin Connect app › tap the device › System › Software Update

products.name: Apple TV
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › Software Updates › Update Software

products.name: Roku TV or streaming stick
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › System update › Check now

products.name: Amazon Fire TV or Fire Stick
products.how_to_update: Settings › My Fire TV › About › Check for Updates, then Install Update

products.name: Samsung smart TV
products.how_to_update: Settings › Support › Software Update › Update Now (newer models: Settings › All Settings › Support). Turn on Auto Update.

products.name: LG smart TV
products.how_to_update: Settings › All Settings › Support › Software Update. Turn on Automatic update.

products.name: Google TV, Chromecast or Android TV
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › About › System update

products.name: Vizio TV
products.how_to_update: Updates itself when on Wi-Fi. To check: Menu › System › Check for Updates

products.name: Android phone (any brand)
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › Software update (also: Settings › Security › Google Play system update)
products.caveat: Chipset flaws (Qualcomm, Arm Mali, MediaTek) only affect phones with that chip. Say 'may affect you' unless the user's model is known.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy
products.how_to_update: Settings › Software update › Download and install

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Tab
products.how_to_update: Settings › Software update › Download and install

products.name: Amazon Fire tablet
products.how_to_update: Settings › Device Options › System Updates › Check Now

products.name: Kindle e-reader
products.how_to_update: Updates itself over Wi-Fi. To check: Settings › the ⋮ menu › Update Your Kindle (greyed out means you are up to date)

products.name: Google Pixel
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › Software update

products.name: Motorola phone
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › System updates

products.name: Windows PC
products.how_to_update: Start › Settings › Windows Update › Check for updates, then restart

products.name: Microsoft Surface
products.how_to_update: Start › Settings › Windows Update › Check for updates, then restart. Surface firmware comes through Windows Update too.

products.name: Mac
products.how_to_update: Apple menu › System Settings › General › Software Update

products.name: Chromebook
products.how_to_update: Settings › About ChromeOS › Check for updates, then restart

products.name: ASUS laptop or desktop
products.how_to_update: Use MyASUS app › System Update (ASUS Live Update is retired; uninstall it if present)

products.name: Chrome
products.how_to_update: Computer: ⋮ › Help › About Google Chrome › Relaunch. Phone: app store › Chrome › Update

products.name: Microsoft Edge
products.how_to_update: … menu › Help and feedback › About Microsoft Edge › Restart
products.caveat: Edge is built on Chromium. Chromium flaws usually reach Edge too, but Microsoft ships the fix a few days after Google.

products.name: Brave, Opera or Vivaldi
products.how_to_update: Open the browser's menu › About › let it update › Relaunch
products.caveat: Built on Chromium; each company ships Google's fix on its own schedule.

products.name: Safari
products.how_to_update: Safari updates with your iPhone, iPad or Mac software update
products.caveat: On iPhone and iPad, every browser (including Chrome) uses Apple's WebKit, so WebKit flaws affect all of them.

products.name: Firefox
products.how_to_update: ☰ menu › Help › About Firefox › Restart to update

products.name: Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
products.how_to_update: Open Word › File › Account › Update Options › Update Now

products.name: Outlook (desktop app)
products.how_to_update: Outlook › File › Office Account › Update Options › Update Now

products.name: WhatsApp
products.how_to_update: App Store or Google Play › WhatsApp › Update

products.name: Adobe Acrobat / Reader
products.how_to_update: Open Acrobat › Help › Check for Updates

products.name: WinRAR
products.how_to_update: WinRAR does not update itself: install the newest version from the maker's official site (type the address yourself)

products.name: 7-Zip
products.how_to_update: 7-Zip does not update itself: install the newest version from the maker's official site (type the address yourself)

products.name: Java
products.how_to_update: Windows: Start › Configure Java › Update tab › Update Now

products.name: Messaging apps (Telegram, Signal, Messenger, Discord, Snapchat)
products.how_to_update: iPhone: App Store › tap your picture › Update All. Android: Play Store › tap your picture › Manage apps & device › Update all. Computer: open the app and look for Check for updates.

products.name: Social apps (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube)
products.how_to_update: iPhone: App Store › tap your picture › Update All. Android: Play Store › tap your picture › Manage apps & device › Update all. Computer: open the app and look for Check for updates.

products.name: Zoom or Microsoft Teams
products.how_to_update: Zoom: tap your picture › Check for Updates. Teams: updates itself; restart it. Phone: update from the app store.

products.name: AI chat apps (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok)
products.how_to_update: iPhone: App Store › tap your picture › Update All. Android: Play Store › tap your picture › Manage apps & device › Update all. Computer: open the app and look for Check for updates.

products.name: Password manager (1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass, iCloud Keychain)
products.how_to_update: iPhone: App Store › tap your picture › Update All. Android: Play Store › tap your picture › Manage apps & device › Update all. Computer: open the app and look for Check for updates.

products.name: Remote access app (TeamViewer, AnyDesk, ScreenConnect)
products.how_to_update: iPhone: App Store › tap your picture › Update All. Android: Play Store › tap your picture › Manage apps & device › Update all. Computer: open the app and look for Check for updates.
products.caveat: If a stranger, a pop-up or a caller asked you to install this, someone may be in your computer. Open "I think I got hacked".

products.name: Notepad++
products.how_to_update: Notepad++ › ? menu › Update Notepad++

products.name: TP-Link router
products.how_to_update: TP-Link Tether or Deco app › your router › Firmware update

products.name: Netgear router
products.how_to_update: Nighthawk or Orbi app › Settings › Router firmware

products.name: D-Link router
products.how_to_update: D-Link app or the router's settings page › Firmware
products.caveat: Many exploited D-Link models are end-of-life and will never be fixed; the advice is to replace them.

products.name: ASUS router
products.how_to_update: ASUS Router app › Settings › Firmware upgrade

products.name: Tenda router
products.how_to_update: Tenda WiFi app › Settings › Firmware upgrade

products.name: Zyxel router or modem
products.how_to_update: Router settings page › Maintenance › Firmware

products.name: Ubiquiti (UniFi / AmpliFi)
products.how_to_update: UniFi app › Settings › Control Plane › Updates

products.name: Internet company's box (Xfinity, Spectrum, AT&T…)
products.how_to_update: Usually updated automatically by your internet company; restart it if they announce a fix

products.name: Amazon eero
products.how_to_update: Updates itself. To check: eero app › Settings › Software Updates

products.name: Starlink
products.how_to_update: Updates itself overnight (around 3 AM). To check: Starlink app › Settings › Starlink › Software Updates
products.caveat: A kit left unplugged for months misses updates. Plug it in with a view of the sky now and then so it can catch up.

products.name: Google Nest Wifi or Google Wifi
products.how_to_update: Updates itself; there is nothing to install. Keep the Google Home app updated.

products.name: Linksys router
products.how_to_update: Linksys app › your network › look for Firmware Update and turn on automatic updates

products.name: DrayTek router
products.how_to_update: Router's admin page › System Maintenance › Firmware Upgrade

products.name: TRENDnet router or camera
products.how_to_update: Router's admin page › Administrator › Firmware upgrade (download only from TRENDnet's own support page)

products.name: D-Link camera or recorder
products.how_to_update: mydlink app › your camera › Firmware

products.name: Hikvision camera or recorder
products.how_to_update: Hik-Connect app › your device › Device Upgrade, or the recorder's menu › Maintenance › Upgrade
products.caveat: Many store-brand cameras are made by Hikvision. Check the label or the app you use to view them.

products.name: Dahua camera or recorder
products.how_to_update: DMSS app › your device › Device Upgrade, or the recorder's menu › System › Upgrade
products.caveat: Some other camera brands use Dahua hardware. Check the label or the app you use to view them.

products.name: Home storage drive (Synology, QNAP)
products.how_to_update: Open the drive's web page › Control Panel › Update

products.name: Ring doorbell or camera
products.how_to_update: Updates itself over Wi-Fi. To check: Ring app › your device › Device Health › Firmware should say Up to Date

products.name: Blink camera
products.how_to_update: Updates itself while the camera is online. Keep the Blink app updated too.

products.name: Wyze camera or plug
products.how_to_update: Wyze app › Account › Firmware Update › Update all

products.name: Google Nest camera, doorbell or thermostat
products.how_to_update: Updates itself over Wi-Fi; there is nothing to install. Keep the Google Home app updated.

products.name: Arlo camera
products.how_to_update: Arlo app › Settings › My Devices › your camera › Device Info › Firmware (update if offered)

products.name: eufy camera or doorbell
products.how_to_update: eufy Security app › your device › Settings › About Device › check firmware

products.name: Amazon Echo or Alexa device
products.how_to_update: Updates itself. To check, say: "Alexa, check for software updates"

products.name: TP-Link Kasa or Tapo plug or camera
products.how_to_update: Kasa or Tapo app › your device › Settings › Firmware Update

products.name: Gmail / Google account
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; alerts cover breaches, outages and scams

products.name: Outlook.com / Microsoft 365 account
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; alerts cover breaches, outages and scams

products.name: Bank or credit union
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; alerts cover breaches and scams

products.name: Crypto exchange (Coinbase, Binance, Kraken…)
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; alerts cover hacks, outages and scams

products.name: Apple Account (iCloud)
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; alerts cover breaches, outages and scams

products.name: Amazon account
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; alerts cover breaches, outages and scams

products.name: Phone carrier (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile…)
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install. Turn on a port-out PIN or number lock in your carrier account to block SIM swaps.

products.name: PlayStation
products.how_to_update: PS5: Settings › System › System Software › System Software Update and Settings › Update System Software. PS4: Settings › System Software Update.

products.name: Xbox
products.how_to_update: Settings › System › Updates

products.name: Nintendo Switch
products.how_to_update: System Settings › System › System Update

products.name: Steam or Steam Deck
products.how_to_update: Steam Deck: Settings › System › Check for updates. Computer: Steam menu › Check for Steam Client Updates.

products.name: HP printer
products.how_to_update: On the printer's screen or in the HP Smart app, look for Printer Update and turn on automatic updates

products.name: Canon printer
products.how_to_update: On the printer's screen, look for Setup › Firmware update (or in the Canon PRINT app)

products.name: Epson printer
products.how_to_update: On the printer's screen: Settings › Firmware Update (or in the Epson Smart Panel app)

products.name: Brother printer
products.how_to_update: Brother Mobile Connect app or the printer's screen: look for Firmware Update

products.name: PayPal or Venmo
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; keep the app updated. Alerts cover breaches, outages and scams.

products.name: Cash App
products.how_to_update: Nothing to install; keep the app updated. Alerts cover breaches, outages and scams.

products.name: Crypto wallet app (MetaMask, Phantom, Trust, Coinbase Wallet)
products.how_to_update: Update only from the official app store or the browser extension store.
products.caveat: No real wallet or support agent will ever ask for your recovery phrase. Anyone who asks is stealing.

products.name: Ledger or Trezor hardware wallet
products.how_to_update: Update firmware only inside Ledger Live or Trezor Suite, with the device plugged in.
products.caveat: Never type your recovery phrase into a computer, phone or website. Real updates never ask for it.

products.name: Tesla
products.how_to_update: Touchscreen: Controls › Software. Updates install over Wi-Fi.

products.name: Other car with an app or over-the-air updates
products.how_to_update: The car's screen: look for Settings › Software update, or ask the dealer at your next service. Keep the car's app updated.
